info.title: SchoolSense Enterprise Campus OS - REST API Specification
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the SchoolSense Multi-Tenant Campus Management System. Includes authentication, academic matrices, attendance diaries, homework feeds, marksheets, grievance ticketing, and communication circulars with detailed payload and response examples.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Token issuance, multi-tenant credential verification, profile inspection, and campus switching

tags.name: Timetable

tags.name: Homework

tags.name: Exams & Marks

tags.name: Complaints & Grievances
tags.description: Multi-tier grievance tickets, role-scoped inboxes, delegation, and real-time conversation threads

tags.name: Communication
tags.description: Broadcast circulars, school notices, and academic events calendar

tags.name: Fees & Invoicing
tags.description: Session-scoped fee structures, monthly billing batches, counter collections, invoice ledgers, and official receipts

tags.name: Transport & Fleet
